desk.headline: HEPS jumps to 102.03c as revenue rises 52% to R5.5bn despite Zambia losses; order book up to R18.5bn; no dividend
results: Contract revenue rose 52% to R5.5bn from R3.7bn on higher activity.
HEPS came in at 102.03c and EPS more than tripled to 102.54c from 28.96c; profit rose to R171.5m from R48.4m.
Operating profit before investment income grew 18% to R190m, held back by significant losses in Zambia.
The order book grew to R18.5bn from R17.2bn in February, with R7.3bn of it outside South Africa.

guidance.summary: No earnings targets were given. The sources opened did not include the company's prospects section, but about R14bn of the order book runs beyond February 2028.

points: The company credits the improvement to more work on site and strong project performance.
It flags that significant losses in its Zambia operation partly offset the gains.
call.source: Company results announcement (via InsidEntity) and Business Day coverage, 24 Nov 2026; no management interview found

watch: Whether the Zambia operation stops losing money.
Turning the larger R18.5bn order book, including R14bn of longer-dated work, into profit.
Whether the board resumes dividends as earnings recover.
